primitives_introduced.name: validate_adr_placement
primitives_introduced.purpose: FR-10 ADR-location validator; scans repo for ADR-*.md files outside canonical adrs/; emits JSON findings; exit 0=clean / exit 2=block per IN-010 convention.
consumed_by: finalize-deliverable-packager (Step 14 packager check, replacing FR-1-deleted prose)

edits.change: Delete retired '### 3. ADR cross-location check' dual-location BLOCKER prose; replace with '### 3. ADR placement validator' that subprocess-invokes validate_adr_placement.py and lifts findings into packager-report.json.
Add 'Bash' to tools list (per Q-CC-5-A recommendation) to enable subprocess invocation of validate_adr_placement.py.
Delete contradictory dual-location BLOCKER check; post-ADR-0036 statement at lines 470-472 becomes sole ADR-placement convention in the file.
Expand output_adrs_dir parameter description to cite default 'adrs/' (canonical-root) per ADR-0036 and reference the test-only override mechanism.
Form unchanged (output_adrs_dir/ADR-<NNNN>.md continues); semantics now flow from the new line-48 default.
Add a short 'Test override for output_adrs_dir' subsection (3-6 lines) documenting fixture-only override surface.
Modify design-composer parameter-list entry from bare 'output_adrs_dir' to explicit-default form citing 'adrs/' default and ADR-0036.

Add orchestrator-stage validator gate: subprocess-invoke validate_adr_placement.py between design-composer return and shared-document-reviewer invocation; on exit 2, halt stage and surface BLOCKER via AskUserQuestion.
Add validate_adr_placement.py to the parallel-dispatch set; fold its findings into the 'validator' dimension (per Q-CC-7 Option A).
Add positive-path smoke (clean repo state → exit 0) and negative-path smoke (fixture with feature-scoped ADR → exit 2) for validate_adr_placement.py.
Remove or amend the stale backward-compat clause; recommend remove (consistent with FR-10 empty-allowlist post-condition).
Rewrite example paths to canonical 'adrs/ADR-NNNN-*' form or generic <slug>/<id> placeholders.
Rewrite worked-example header to canonical-path-form examples.
Rewrite path-only example to canonical form.

Per Q-CC-4: ADR-output target output/synthesis-<topic>/adrs/ remains; the validator allowlists this path (default expectation). No SKILL.md text edit unless Composer selects Option B (re-target) or Option C (deprecate).

primitives_unchanged.rationale: Per KB-cc-design Principle 5 (one-source-of-truth) and Principle 1 (lowest-cost), the canonical-only convention already lives in ADR-0036, deliverable-archive-spec.md post-amendment, and shared-conventions.md:302. Adding a CLAUDE.md directive duplicates existing sources.

Per Principle 2 (path-gate everything) + Principle 1: validator enforcement is mechanical/deterministic; an instruction-based rule would be guidance-only, not enforced. Validator is the lower-cost + higher-guarantee mechanism.

The 'execution-pipeline hook' surface per FR-10-c is the existing run_phase_checks.py subprocess hook, NOT a Claude Code settings.json lifecycle hook. A PostToolUse hook would only fire on model edit-tool usage, missing orchestrator-side writes; would also pollute every CC session in the repo.
Validator is pure Python stdlib; no external service.
Per Principle 7 (plugins-for-distribution-not-organization): scope is repo-internal; nothing distributed cross-project.
Out of scope; no non-coding mode addition.

permission_policy_changes.rationale: Per KB-cc-design Principle 6 (permissions-as-safety-net): smallest possible grant to enable Q-CC-5-A. Broader pattern (auditing-shared/scripts/*.py) rejected as lowering safety-net specificity.

internal_dependencies.edge_notes: rglob ADR-*.md; verifies each match's parent dir == adrs/ or adrs/superseded/.

After FR-8d completes, this directory no longer exists; the scan is a no-op. During mid-migration (Phase 2 in-flight) the validator is NOT yet wired into the three surfaces (per Q-CC-6 Option B); no allowlist needed.

internal_dependencies.via: Bash tool (per Q-CC-5-A) invoked at Step 14 '### 3. ADR placement validator'

provides_to.mechanism: FR-1 deletes the dual-location BLOCKER prose; FR-10-d replaces with canonical-only check; the deferred disposition is closeable when this feature ships.

cross_layer_concerns.rationale: Codebase analysis confirms no .github/workflows/*.yml currently invokes Claude Code or any auditing-shared script. The validator runs locally (in Codespace, during the pipeline) and at three CC-internal surfaces. No CI integration needed.
